option_relations.rationale: The option Amelanotic Malignant Melanoma matches the leaf label Amelanotic Malignant Melanoma of the Caruncle.
Caruncular melanoma is a subtype of melanoma, which includes amelanotic malignant melanoma of the caruncle and mucosal melanoma of the caruncle.
Amelanotic Melanoma is a broader class that includes amelanotic malignant melanoma of the caruncle, conjunctival melanoma, and mucosal melanoma of the caruncle.
Conjunctival melanoma (amelanotic variant) matches the leaf label Conjunctival Melanoma (Amelanotic Variant).
